results.title: Cheapest H100 and B200 Cloud: CoreWeave vs Nebius vs Lambda vs Crusoe · Aliteq
results.author: Aliteq Team
highlights:
On each provider's own pricing page on Nov 3, 2026, Crusoe had the cheapest on-demand H100 ($3.90 a GPU-hour, rising to $4.50 on Dec 1) and Lambda the cheapest B200 ($6.69). CoreWeave was the most expensive on demand, but its fixed spot prices undercut everyone's on-demand rate. The full table, the catches, and where the marketplace tier sits.

Aliteq Team· Updated Nov 3, 2026· Published Aug 24, 2026· 8 min read

Which big GPU cloud is cheapest for H100 and B200? On each provider's own pricing page on November 3, 2026: for the H100, Crusoe at $3.90 per GPU-hour on demand, with Lambda a cent behind at $3.99 on an 8-GPU instance. For the B200, Lambda at $6.69 per GPU-hour (8x), well under Nebius ($8.50) and CoreWeave ($8.60). CoreWeave is the most expensive on demand, but if your job can be interrupted its published spot prices ($2.46 an H100, $4.26 a B200, per GPU) undercut everyone's on-demand rate. Two dates to know: Crusoe's own page says its H100 goes to $4.50 on December 1, 2026, which hands the cheapest on-demand H100 to Lambda.

## The short answer (read Nov 3, 2026)

Among CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda and Crusoe, the cheapest on-demand H100 on November 3, 2026 was Crusoe at $3.90 per GPU-hour, then Lambda at $3.99 (8x instance), Nebius at $4.50 and CoreWeave at $6.16 (an 8-GPU node at $49.24 an hour). Crusoe's page says its H100 rises to $4.50 on December 1, 2026. The cheapest on-demand B200 was Lambda at $6.69 per GPU-hour (8x; $6.99 on one GPU), then Nebius at $8.50 and CoreWeave at $8.60; Crusoe's B200 is contact-sales. For interruptible work, CoreWeave's spot nodes work out to $2.46 per H100 and $4.26 per B200, and Nebius preemptible starts from $0.79 (H100) and $0.99 (B200) at a dynamic rate. Smaller clouds go lower still: Hyperstack listed a B200 at $6.00 and an H100 at $2.50.

- Cheapest H100 on demand: Crusoe $3.90 (until Dec 1), Lambda $3.99 (8x), single H100 PCIe at Lambda $3.29
- Cheapest B200 on demand: Lambda $6.69 (8x) to $6.99 (1x)
- Most expensive on demand: CoreWeave, $6.16 per H100 and $8.60 per B200
- Cheapest if you can be interrupted: CoreWeave spot, $2.46 per H100 and $4.26 per B200; Nebius preemptible is dynamic
- Below the big four: Hyperstack B200 $6.00, H100 $2.50; Vast.ai H100 SXM from $2.40

So if you book on-demand H100 time today for a run that crosses December 1, price the December hours at $4.50.

The catch on the cheapest numbers

Lambda has the lowest on-demand B200, but it lists no spot or preemptible tier. Nebius's preemptible prices ("from $0.79" for H100 and H200, "from $0.99" for B200 and B300) are floors, and Nebius says spot prices are dynamic and "may vary during the active use, including as frequently as every 15 minutes." Its live spot widget on Nov 3, 2026 showed a B200 at $5.70 in me-west1, up 39% on the week. A listed price also doesn't guarantee capacity, at any of the four.

CoreWeave per-GPU figures are its 8-GPU node prices divided by eight (North America). "From" prices are floors, and spot and preemptible prices move. Vast and Runpod prices come from our own price feed (snapshot 15:20 UTC, Nov 3, 2026), which also powers the compare page. A listed price doesn't guarantee capacity. We earn referral fees from Vast and Runpod, not from CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, Hyperstack or GMI Cloud, and that doesn't change any number on this page.

# Best GPU Neoclouds 2026: CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, and Groq Ranked by Published Pricing and Contracted Power

By

Asif Razzaq

August 23, 2026

The ‘neocloud’ label now covers five companies with very different business models. CoreWeave and Nebius are public companies that publish quarterly results and file reports with the SEC (CoreWeave on Form 10-Q, Nebius as a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K). Lambda and Crusoe are private and heading toward IPOs. Groq has run GroqCloud on its LPU architecture since 2024; after licensing that technology to NVIDIA in December 2025, the independent Groq refocused entirely on inference-cloud infrastructure. This article compares them on what actually matters to a buyer: published pricing, deployed and contracted power, hardware roadmap, contract structure, and independent quality ratings.

## TL;DR

- CoreWeave is the only Platinum-rated GPU cloud in SemiAnalysis ClusterMAX 2.0 and commands premium list pricing on H100, H200, and B200.
- Nebius is the only provider here publishing B300 on-demand pricing; Lambda publishes the lowest B200 on-demand rate.
- Lambda still publishes the cheapest on-demand B200 ($6.69/GPU-hr) but has no spot tier.
- Crusoe is the only provider here with AMD MI300X/MI355X on its rate card.
- Groq is now an NVIDIA Cloud Partner and plans to add NVIDIA GPU capacity alongside its LPU inference cloud.

### What the table shows

CoreWeave charges a premium and publishes the most complete card. Its H100 rate of $6.16/GPU-hr is about 60% above Nebius and Lambda. SemiAnalysis reports CoreWeave commands roughly 10–15% more per GPU-hour than Nebius, Crusoe, Lambda, and Fluidstack on managed Slurm or Kubernetes clusters, and that its pricing sits closer to the big hyperscalers. CoreWeave is also the only one of the four publishing a GB200 NVL72 on-demand price.

Nebius undercuts CoreWeave on Blackwell and is the only one with B300 on-demand. Its B200 rate of $7.15 is below CoreWeave’s $8.60, and its $7.85 B300 rate has no published competitor in this group. Preemptible rates run roughly 45% below on-demand.

Lambda holds the cheapest published B200 instance at $6.69. Its 1-Click Clusters (16 to 2,000+ GPUs, 2-week to 1-year terms) are priced higher: $9.86, $9.36, and $8.87 per B200-hour at 16, 64, and 256+ GPUs respectively. Lambda has no spot tier. Third-party trackers note Lambda raised its H100 SXM rate from $2.99 to $3.99 over 2025–2026 as demand outran supply. 

Crusoe is the only AMD option and the cheapest H200 at $4.29. Its H100 rate of $3.90 is close to Nebius and Lambda. B200, GB200, and MI355X require a sales conversation.

# Neocloud GPU rates: $2.00 to $2.50 per hour. | Stephen Peters · LinkedIn · 2026-08-24T00:00:00+00:00

**Stephen Peters**: COO at CloudSyntrix | We execute the cloud, data, and DevOps work your team doesn’t have capacity for | 300+ clients, 15+ countries.

---

Neocloud GPU rates: $2.00 to $2.50 per hour.
Equivalent hyperscaler capacity: $3.00 per hour.
Lambda Labs: $3.29 per hour, undercutting hyperscalers by approximately 23%.

Other estimates: 30% to 60% lower overall.

At scale, that pricing gap is not a minor efficiency gain.

But neoclouds rely on long-term multi-year take-or-pay contracts to finance their hardware. An SMB that locks into fixed compute capacity for years on fluctuating AI demand faces a different kind of financial risk than the one it was trying to avoid.

Know the full cost structure before optimizing for the headline rate.

E2E Networks offers H100 spot instances at 65-70% off on-demand rates, bringing spot H100 to roughly Rs 75-90/hr for interruptible workloads. ... For global Blackwell capacity, packet.ai A100 80GB at $0.89/hr (~Rs 75/hr) undercuts domestic A100 on-demand rates with no contracts required.

results.author: Vishal Gouri
highlights:
## The Pricing Battleground: On-Demand GPU Rates

For buyers, pricing remains a critical differentiator. Here’s a snapshot of published on-demand rates (per GPU-hour) as of August 2026, alongside key observations:

- NVIDIA HGX H100: Nebius ($3.85) and Crusoe ($3.90) offer the most competitive rates, closely followed by Lambda ($3.99). CoreWeave’s premium H100 rate sits at $6.16.
- NVIDIA HGX H200: Crusoe leads with the lowest published rate at $4.29, compared to Nebius ($4.50) and CoreWeave ($6.31).
- NVIDIA HGX B200: Lambda offers the cheapest on-demand B200 at $6.69. Nebius is competitive at $7.15, while CoreWeave is priced at $8.60.
- NVIDIA B300: Nebius is the sole provider in this group to publish on-demand B300 pricing at $7.85, with others requiring sales contact.
- AMD GPUs: Crusoe is the only provider listing AMD MI300X ($3.45) and offering MI355X via sales, providing an alternative to NVIDIA-centric offerings.
- Spot and Preemptible Tiers: Nebius offers aggressive preemptible rates (e.g., H100 at $2.15), and CoreWeave provides spot pricing (H100 at $2.46). Lambda does not currently offer a spot tier.
- Egress Costs: Most providers, including CoreWeave, Lambda, and Crusoe, offer free network egress. Nebius provides free network egress but charges for standard object storage egress.
